causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Electricity demand peaked at 3077 MW on 17 March, the highest demand ever recorded in South Australia.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: On 17 March, AGL's initial offer saw three Torrens Island A units and four B units online (a total of 1160 MW) with 250 MW offered at the price floor and 910 MW offered above $5000/MWh. At 7.10 am AGL rebid 580 MW from prices above $5000/MWh to prices below $60/MWh. The reason given was '20:02 N Predispatch Demand change: Increase in Vic Demand'. This left 310 MW priced above $5000/MWh at the time of high prices.
